Method.name: Process835RestultSet
Method.Description: Method to process the result set and generate file The result set has 3 columns (fields). 1. RecordType -> 1= File Header,5-> Batch Header, 6-> Entry Detail, 7-> Addenda Record, 8-> Batch Control, 9-> File Control 2. FieldID 3. Field value. The methods reads the result set sequentially and expects it to have the result sent in sequence. The output file has following structure File Header[Batch Header[EntryDetail,Addenda Record]Batch Control]File Control where []-> Indicates repeat
